root_cause: Powerhouse had mature sales techniques, persuasion rules, relationship intelligence, copy guidance and channel executors, but the selected strategy and psychology were not consistently runtime-decisive before message generation and provider execution.
decision: Keep the existing persuasion optimizer as psychology authority and make one evidence-bound runtime chain from sales action to channel play, human copy, deterministic quality gate, provider acknowledgement, outcome and revenue learning.
prevention: no outbound execution without a current strategy, persuasion decision and quality pass
persuasion may change framing but never fabricate evidence, urgency, scarcity or personal facts
trigger outreach requires human-readable source context; irrelevant predicted triggers are ignored
follow-up must introduce a new evidence-backed angle and may not guilt the prospect
one primary problem and at most one CTA per message
channel executors keep consent, pressure, dedupe, identity, capability and provider acknowledgement gates authoritative
strategy, psychology, CTA and quality evidence are persisted with the action so observed outcomes can train later decisions
composer v2 requires a source-specific personalization anchor from readable prospect evidence before outbound copy can pass
Gmail and SalesRobot must reject drafts whose composer proof is not the current powerhouse-human-commercial-message-composer-v2 contract
symptom: Planner strategy labels existed but generic outbound copy could still bypass their full behavioral intent.
Sales and copy psychology existed in documentation and optimizer layers without one deterministic pre-send runtime contract.
failed_approaches: Treat sales psychology as documentation-only guidance.
Generate generic channel templates first and apply strategy only as metadata afterward.
Create a second persuasion authority instead of reusing the existing optimizer.

delivery_closure.runtime_readback: 17/17 strategy; 17/17 persuasion; 15 quality-passed drafts; 14 provider acknowledgements/30d
delivery_closure.rule: Commercial persuasion runtime changes must preserve evidence truth, pre-send quality gating and provider/outcome lineage in one candidate.
delivery_closure.v2_followup: live composer v18 plus Gmail v16 plus LinkedIn sales machine v13 synchronized to source control
